claims.title: Exact sparse Farkas infeasibility certificate for rational prior ambiguity
claims.scope: empty finite rational prior polytopes after exact simplex-coordinate elimination
assumptions: the transformed ambiguity system is Cx<=d with rational coefficients
the normalized Farkas witness satisfies y>=0, C^T y=0, and one^T y=1
all normalized witness bases below the configured cap are exhausted
nonclaims: the certificate proves inconsistency of the declared inequalities but does not identify which modeling assumption should be relaxed
active-basis enumeration is not a large-instance polynomial-time guarantee

claims.title: Exact rational primal-dual certificate for polyhedral expectation extrema
claims.scope: linear expectations over nonempty bounded rational prior polytopes
assumptions: after simplex elimination the primal is max constant+c^T x subject to Cx<=d
the dual is min constant+d^T y subject to C^T y=c and y>=0
minimization is certified by applying the maximum dual to the negated value vector
nonclaims: zero rational duality gap is a certificate for the declared finite LP rather than a statistical coverage claim
dual multipliers are not automatically physical prices or parent-substrate resource costs

claims.title: Bounded independent Farkas and expectation-dual audit
claims.scope: the contradictory interval, incompatible-halfspace, interval-expectation, Huber K4, and constant-objective instances exercised by the repository
assumptions: all configured Farkas and dual basis searches complete below their caps
all arithmetic in the certificate path is exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded agreement is not a scalability theorem
a passing CI run is not itself the mathematical proof object
